name: Dunya Rahim
about:
I'm a recent Information Science graduate from the University of Maryland passionate about using data and technology to build real, useful solutions—from responsive websites to analyzing 300k+ SQL records for trends and insights.

I've built tools like a Pinterest Engagement CLI, a TaskTrackr command-line app, an interactive Tableau dashboard on gun violence data, and SQL projects focused on pattern analysis—strengthening my skills in Python, SQL, JavaScript, Tableau, and clean, user-friendly design.

I enjoy exploring new tech, understanding how products are built, and making data easier to understand—whether that means analyzing datasets, integrating APIs, or building something from scratch that solves a real problem.

projects.name: Gun Violence in America – Interactive Tableau Dashboard & Story
projects.description: Built a multi-sheet Tableau workbook and story analyzing national incident data: casualty trends over time, casualties by incident type, and victim demographics by age. Created comparative views (Top States/Cities by Casualties) and an analytical "Who Is Most Affected?" dashboard to translate raw data into a clear narrative for stakeholders.

projects.name: Pinterest Engagement CLI
projects.description: Analyzes engagement trends (likes, comments) from CSV using SQLite and Matplotlib.

projects.name: TaskTrackr (CLI)
projects.description: Command-line to-do tracker with priorities and due dates using argparse and JSON; includes unit tests.

projects.name: Montgomery County Crime SQL Analysis
projects.description: SQL analysis of 300k+ records to find trends by ZIP, agency, and crime type; led ERD design and normalization.

projects.name: Mini Portfolio Generator
projects.description: A personal portfolio website built with vanilla JS, HTML, and CSS, generating all content from a JSON file. Fully responsive and hosted with GitHub Pages.

projects.name: 5-Day Weather Forecast CLI
projects.description: API-based CLI that fetches and prints a five-day forecast using OpenWeatherMap.

experience.summary: Used SQL Server, Excel, and Active Directory to deliver Tier I/II Windows Server support, document incidents and configurations, and report on technical issues to support data-driven decisions.
Conducted research on digital collections focused on metadata standards and digital preservation; performed data analysis to evaluate archival methods.
Troubleshot hardware and software issues; supported IT systems management; improved user experience.
